Hi Dave,

Thanks for the kind word, and sorry again for the mix-up on the region.

Nothing more is needed from you. The U. antenna is going out separately from our US warehouse at no cost, and the tracking for it will reach you at the same address as the rest of your order. If anything looks off when both arrive, just reply here and I'll sort it.

Enjoy the Airsquitter, and good luck with the points.

Sarah
HeliumDeploy Support
